mock_verification.statement: the 21 requests and their token counts are MOCK/SIMULATED; they are not provider usage and not cost

errors: source drift or missing (unregistered digest): experiments/runners/crewai_capture_v19.py

real_api_path.evidence: experiments/commands/run_crewai_r19_acquisition.py uses OpenAICompat-style client from crewai_capture_v19 with --mode api + --confirm-send-synthetic-data; the mock and the api paths share one code path, differing only in the client

exceptions_and_cap_charged.evidence: CapturedOpenAICompatCrewAILLM consumes the request slot BEFORE send, records status=error with error_type and zero tokens, and re-raises; the cap test asserts no provider call is attempted beyond the budget

credential_scan.evidence: the key is read from the environment only and passed to the client; scanning the r19 manifest, results and reports for sk- patterns: no sk- pattern found in r19 artefacts

audit_negative_controls.evidence: deleted field, corrupted record, token tamper, action rebinding, freeze hash tamper and unregistered source digest each make the audit report errors; the clean control stays complete

freeze_source_pinning.evidence: the freeze file is unmodified (e4a9e5f74266e920) and every pin resolves through the amendment's authority; an unregistered digest fails (see the negative control)

per_attempt_full_capture.evidence: each attempt stores the full input messages, raw and normalized output, provider usage, the request slot, the host parsed Action and the executed tool, plus the cache split and timestamps

cache_metering.evidence: prompt_cache_hit_tokens / prompt_cache_miss_tokens / cache_tokens_source / utc_started / utc_finished / off_peak_window per attempt; absent splits are labelled absent

cost_estimate.output_price_assumption: the handoff quoted the cache-hit and cache-miss input prices only; the output price used here is a stated stand-in, so the estimate is an upper bound on the input side and indicative on the output side

real_run_projection.basis: the r17/r19 measured frames are about 1.9k provider tokens per first-role call and about 120 output tokens per call
